newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares slip after Chidambaram's exclusion.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares slip after Chidambaram's exclusion.

text.p: Delhi shares slipped in cautious afternoon trade on Monday after Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral excluded outgoing finance minister P. Chidambaram from his new council of ministers, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was 3.01 points lower at 779.03 at 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT).
"Players are now anxiously awaiting the allocation of the finance portfolio," said Narinder Vaishisht of brokers Indu Portfolio.
After being sworn in, Gujral said he would hold the finance portfolio.

Chidambaram's Tamil Maanila Congress party on Saturday decided to stay out of the government after its leader, G.K. Moopanar, was passed over in the wrangling to select a new leader for the coalition.
Reliance Industries dropped 2.00 rupees to 285.00 ahead of the announcement of its annual results, due on Tuesday.
But State Bank of India bucked the trend to quote 1.35 rupees higher on buying by foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
